records.limitations: Scores one benchmark essay. The official three-teammate session produces three different responses and uses human judges; stage timing and cross-paper editing are not reproduced.

criteria.name: Clarity
criteria.description: Assign 15-25 using the official questions: readability and navigation; minimal grammar, syntax, and spelling errors; understanding of the prompt.

criteria.name: Content
criteria.description: Assign 15-25 using the official questions: relevant and thought-provoking ideas and facts; sensible conclusions; effective use of World Scholar's Cup subject knowledge.

criteria.name: Style
criteria.description: Assign 15-25 using the official questions: engaging language, appropriate style, varied vocabulary, and an enjoyable reading experience.
